name: Marriage Divorce And Remarriage
overview: Scripture presents marriage as a sacred union ordained by God, emphasizing that what God has joined together should not be separated by man (Matthew 19:6). Divorce is permitted in limited circumstances, specifically for the cause of fornication, but is generally viewed with sorrow and disapproval, as the LORD hates putting away (Malachi 2:16). Those who divorce without biblical grounds cause spiritual harm, leading to adultery for both the one who divorces and the one who remarries (Matthew 5:32; Matthew 19:9). The Old Testament law provided procedures for divorce, yet the New Testament calls believers to uphold the sanctity of marriage as a lifelong covenant (Deuteronomy 24:1; Matthew 19:1).
